body: Hello, we cannot cover all 40 bottles of the 1 litre sanitiser refill. We can send 20 bottles at 6.34 EUR each, delivery in 4 days. Let us know if that works.
Thanks for your enquiry. Our stock of 22G needles is limited: we can offer only 24 boxes, not the 80 you asked for. Price 3.38 euros per box, delivery in 7 days.
Good afternoon. For the cotton wool balls we have 60 bags available right now, which is short of your 80. The price is 1.66 EUR per bag and we ship in 2 days.
Partial offer: 18 sharps containers (2 litre) instead of 24, at EUR 2.47 each. The rest is back-ordered. Delivery of the 18 units in 5 days.
We can supply 150 packs of the 7.5 x 7.5 gauze swabs, not the full 200. Price: 3.11 EUR per pack of 100. Delivery in 2 days. Kind regards, Order desk.
Unfortunately only 90 bottles of the 500 ml ethyl alcohol are on hand out of the 150 requested. 2.04 euros per bottle, delivery in 5 days.
Dear customer, the glucose strips are in short supply. We can allocate 60 boxes of 50 against your request for 80, at 12.42 EUR a box, 3 days to deliver.
We have just 30 boxes of no. 10 scalpels available (you requested 60). Price per box of 10 is 5.09 EUR. Dispatch within 5 days.
Hi, for the insulin syringes we can only offer 14 boxes right now, not 24. Price is 11.45 euros per box of 100, delivery 2 days.
Our allocation of 1 litre alcohol is half of what you need: 40 bottles out of 80. Each bottle is 2.93 EUR. We would deliver in 3 days.
We are able to offer 22 boxes of FFP2 masks (20 per box) at the moment instead of 30. Price 11.55 EUR per box. Lead time is 14 days as the balance comes from the factory.
Regarding the 500 Foley catheters boxes: we can only commit 150 boxes for now. The price is 25.32 euros per box of 10 and delivery takes 3 days. Remaining quantity cannot be promised.
Dear buyer, thank you for the request. The 60 ml sterile urine containers are currently out of stock and we have no date for new arrivals. We cannot quote this time.
Hello, the safety lancets 28G in boxes of 200 have been discontinued by the manufacturer, so we are unable to make you an offer. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Thanks for contacting us. Unfortunately we do not carry pen needles of any gauge, so we cannot quote this item. You may want to try a diabetes care specialist.
We regret to say that we have no capacity to supply the island dressings you request. Our production is fully booked for this period, so we must decline.
Hi, the 1 ml luer slip syringes are sold out and we do not expect stock soon. We are therefore not able to send you a quotation.
The compression stockings class I in size L are no longer produced; the line was discontinued last season. We have to decline your request.
Good morning. We do not sell children's plasters with drawings, it is outside our range. Sorry we cannot help with this one.
Thank you for thinking of us. Due to workload at our warehouse we cannot take on a new order for lumbar belts at present, so we are unable to offer.
Unfortunately the 50 ml luer lock syringes are out of stock at the moment and the next shipment is not confirmed. No offer from us on this item.
Dear Sir or Madam, the XL vinyl gloves have been withdrawn from our catalogue (discontinued). We cannot supply them and will not be quoting.
Thanks for your message. Sterile gauze in envelopes of 8 ply is not a product we stock or distribute, so we are unable to quote.
Hello, we are over capacity this month and cannot commit to supplying the anti-fog goggles. We must decline this request, but thank you for asking.
